description: Search FastCAC's knowledge base: the articles, policies, guides and how-tos FastCAC's team has written (pricing and what it includes, refunds, timelines, documents, what happens after payment, CAC rules and procedures, post-registration steps). Use it before answering a question about FastCAC's service or CAC process that the instructions above don't settle, and answer from the passages, not memory. Returns passages best first, each with its document title, heading, updated_at, a 0-1 rank score and a 0-1 similarity (how close in meaning; about 0.7 and up answers the question), plus total_matches and has_more. Weak or no results: try mode 'broad', reword the query, or page on with offset. If it still has nothing, say plainly that you don't have that information.

document.description: Optional: one document, by title (or part of it) or document_id.

include_context.description: Include the text just before and after each passage.

min_score.description: Optional: drop passages less similar than this (0-1).

mode.description: balanced (default); precise = only close matches; broad = looser matches, weighted to meaning, with each passage's neighbouring text.

offset.description: Skip this many (for the next page).

query.description: The question or keywords, in plain words.

tags.description: Optional: documents with any of these tags.

name: search_knowledge_base

similarity.description: 0-1 closeness in meaning; null in a keyword-only search.

retrieval.description: keyword_only when search by meaning was unavailable.

title: Search FastCAC's knowledge base
